required_corrections.action: Gintautas rawPDF2 SecII: isomer Jπ1−,Kπ0−; ground7−/7−;838.6keV bridge Jπ5−,Kπ4−. Remove invented Kπ3−/4+ bridge. Lowest allowed direct EM is E6, not proof of measured pure E6.

Remove unsupported predominantly allowed-GT statement for 176mLu. A1− parent to positive-parity final state is not allowedGT; without evaluated branch table just say beta decay to176Hf. Gintautas is a rate model using level data, not a new direct branch measurement.

Use dNtotal/dt=−Σd_iN_i+ΣP_i. Closed zero-source is sufficient for conservation. A particular open stationary trajectory may balance feeding/removal; requiring conservation for all initial populations with fixed nonnegative state-independent P and d instead does require both zero. State quantifier.

Unequal constant losses do not force numerical integration: constant A,P=0 gives exp(At)N0, with source add variation-of-constants convolution. Instantaneous eigenvalues alone are generally insufficient; time-varying environments require full propagation, analytic or numerical as appropriate.

Equal common loss D cancels exactly from normalized f=Nm/Ntotal, even if D>0. a+b≫|Dm−Dg| controls leading small-root expansion, but does not by itself show an initially arbitrary population equilibrates while detectable or before cooling/reactions. Keep initial amplitudes and finite environment/observation intervals.

Use J0 for initial compound partial wave and Je,πe,Ee for post-evaporation entry. Define normalized F(entry|E,J0,surv), bbar(E,J0)=ΣJeπe∫F b(entry). σm=ΣJ0σER(E,J0)bbar. Whole b_eff is σER-weighted; denominator must be nonzero. Do not use one J as both pre/post evaporation without an explicit conditional average.

Zagrebaev rawPDF1 Eq1 explicitly approximate three-stage decomposition; rawPDF7 Eqs10–11 integrate evaporated neutron energies and terminal gamma cooling. A representative-trajectory width product is a further approximation. No universal Z1Z2 thresholds or PCN fixed ranges; use source-specific examples/conditions.

Do not universalize B_LD=0 or restore withdrawn numbers. RawPDF7 SecVA No-neighbor model gives B_LD~1.2MeV. ΔB_shell≈−δUgs also assumes saddle shell correction negligible. Shell damping is phenomenological with units/parameters/conditions.

Nonzero entrance spins: use channel transmission T^J_lS or explicitly neglect S dependence. D_fus=d²(Eσfus)/dE² is operational curvature, not automatic bare barrier probability in a system with energy-dependent PCN/quasifission. Distinguish capture/fusion/ER.

Remove absolute only-target/inaccessible-window assertions. Single fixed laboratory τ and fixed flight tf with later window Δt yield e^(−tf/τ)[1−e^(−Δt/τ)]; branch/efficiency separately. Small acceptance is not universally impossible detection; in-flight apparatus differs. No fictional user equipment.
